newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GM considering new uses for Hungarian plant.
newsitem.headline: GM considering new uses for Hungarian plant.

text.p: General Motors Corp said on Thursday that it is considering alternative uses for its Hungarian plant that assembles Opel Astra cars.
"The volume of production is at the low end when we are talking about whether such a plant is feasible," said Albert Lidauer, managing director of Opel Hungary Ltd, a GM subsidiary.
"We are currently studying different alternatives for what the future of such a plant might be."
Alternatives include production of a different vehicle or parts, Lidauer said at a news conference.
The plant, which started operations in March 1992 and has built between 9,400 and 13,400 cars a year, has an annual capacity of roughly 40,000 units.
